note: AD-123 housing ladder (owner, AD-115: I - 2 residents, II - 4, III-VI as the beds allow). beds: residents per house level I..VI; they become capacity only when level_beds is true and a finished project placed the beds. design_research: research a design needs before it may be ordered. birth_interval_research: active ticks between births once the node is done (base population.json birth_interval_ticks).
level_beds_note: On since OWNER-HOUSING-BEDS (2026-09-23): level_bed_cells gives every home@N / home_2@N the beds of its level; HousingLadderGameTests.layoutsMatchBedTargets holds the targets.
level_bed_cells_note: Beds a level adds to the level-I design: foot cell (local x,y,z) and the way the head lies; the cell behind the foot stays free to get in, and no equipment takes any of these cells. home: the ground floor at III (its upper storey has no stair); home_2: the upper storey, reached by its stair, at IV, V and VI.
way_up_note: Cells no equipment of any level may take, so the people reach their beds: in the big house the way from the door lane along z 5 to the foot of the stair at (2,1,7) (the level kits used to fill it and wall the stair in).
